assertions.assertion: Output uses WebApplication.CreateBuilder (minimal hosting) instead of the Startup class pattern
assertions.rationale: Uses WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args) in Program.cs and deletes Startup.cs.

assertions.assertion: Output calls builder.Services.AddIdentityServer() with Duende namespace instead of IdentityServer4
Output calls AddConfigurationStore and AddOperationalStore with UseSqlServer and MigrationsAssembly configuration
assertions.rationale: AddConfigurationStore and AddOperationalStore both use UseSqlServer with MigrationsAssembly(migrationsAssembly).

assertions.assertion: Output includes UseIdentityServer() in the middleware pipeline after UseRouting() and before UseAuthorization()
assertions.rationale: app.UseRouting(); app.UseIdentityServer(); app.UseAuthorization(); in correct order.

assertions.rationale: AddDeveloperSigningCredential removed, with automatic key management / AddSigningCredential explained.
